Presentations today, three sites, all thin: - Bar widget (widget.go:226, weatherwidget.go): one text run - inline WMO glyph + temperature + optional condition word + stale age. The glyph is text, not an icon node: it inherits text tone and metrics, so sysc-58's advance defect applies to it. The tooltip is the static word "Weather" (textWidget.tooltip is a plain string). No Action is set: clicking does nothing. - Control centre weather page (controlcenter_pages.go:349 ccWeather): a Today card that presents raw coordinates ("%.2f deg, %.2f deg") as the location plus "Updated 15:04"; below it four 143x132 forecast cards showing day name, glyph and "H / L" only - no condition word, today excluded, count pinned at four. - No standalone weather panel exists. Data path (weather/client.go, weather/model.go, internal/services/weather.go): the request carries current=temperature_2m,weather_code and daily=weather_code,max,min,sunrise,sunset for seven days. Open-Meteo also returns, and Decode silently discards, elevation and timezone from the response root; the current block can carry is_day, apparent_temperature, humidity, wind_speed_10m, wind_direction_10m and uv_index; the daily block can carry uv_index_max and precipitation figures. The reference panel shows wind, UV, elevation and a named timezone; none of that is reachable today without extending the wire model. Vocabulary drift - three copies of the same facts: - Icon mapping: render/iconfont.go IconRune/IconName (eight WMO glyphs) versus ccWeatherIcon's separate Material ligature set (sunny, partly_cloudy_day, ...) for the same codes. - Condition words: conditionWords (weatherwidget.go:14), ccWeatherCondition, and the plugin's Condition() are three tables. The plugin's routes through IconName; the shell's two do not agree with each other. - No night variants: WMO code 0 at night renders a sun; is_day is not fetched. State handling drift: formatWeather's three-state rule (placeholder / error / stale-with-age) lives in the bar only. ccWeather dashes and "Updated HH:MM" ignore FailedSince, so an aged reading renders identically to a fresh one. Conformance and collision hazards: ccWeather's geometry (Height 336/480, 132; Width 143; Gap 8/12) sits on the open token-conformance worklist, and the parked feature/noctalia-parity session has controlcenter_pages.go dirty in its worktree. This slice must not re-edit that page's geometry concurrently - sequence the cc page after parity lands or confine this slice to new files. EOF )" \ --acceptance "$(cat <<'EOF' - weather.Query/Forecast/Decode extended for current is_day, apparent_temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, uv_index; daily uv_index_max and precipitation; root elevation, timezone, timezone_abbreviation. Decode stays strict: checked pointer fields, bounded body, table tests for the new fields. - One icon mapping and one condition-word table shared by the bar, the control-centre page and the tooltip; night variants for clear and partly-cloudy added to the icon subset and selected via is_day. - The bar weather widget renders a real icon node beside the temperature, opens the weather panel as its Action, and its tooltip carries current facts rather than the literal word "Weather". - A standalone PanelWeather appended to the PanelID enum after PanelNetwork (the blur coverage walk must see it), composed like the reference: hero card (large glyph, temperature, min/max, condition, configured location name - not coordinates), a details card (feels-like, wind, humidity, UV, sunrise, sunset, elevation, timezone), and the seven-day list with per-day icon, day, range and condition word. Daily only; Hourly is a separate decision with its own wire growth. - Stale and error states follow formatWeather's three-state rule on every surface; an aged reading looks aged everywhere. - No new literal geometry: spacing from the margin ladder, control sizes from the density row, shapes from the shape role. The control-centre page's existing literals stay untouched until the parity conversion lands. - Focused checks per changed unit; gofmt, go vet, and the affected-package gates pass before any commit. EOF )")
